description:
Led the end-to-end delivery of a key organizational project, managing a cross-functional team of interns from recruitment through project completion.

- Translated stakeholder business needs into actionable technical plans and project roadmaps, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
- Curated instructional objectives and evaluated outcomes against benchmarks to verify successful competency acquisition.

Designed and delivered multiple full-stack web applications for clients.

- Engineered a high-traffic platform scaled to serve 10,000+ active global users using Next.js and Django.
- Integrated advanced security mechanisms including data anonymity protocols and fine-grained role-based access control (RBAC).
- Managed end-to-end production infrastructure by configuring secure cloud object storage, deployment pipelines, and automated database backups to ensure high availability and data integrity.

Contract position responsible for refining and improving the existing system.

- Streamlined project scope by identifying and eliminating feature bloat, realigning the development roadmap with core business requirements and accelerating delivery.
- Iterated on full-stack features, deploying critical frontend and backend updates driven by user feedback and telemetry data from a pilot program to improve application reliability.
- Hardened and optimized GCP infrastructure, migrating legacy storage assets to secure Google Cloud Storage buckets while achieving 50% cost savings.

Internship focused on backend development and DevOps infrastructure.

- Orchestrated containerized applications using Kubernetes and streamlined cloud deployments on GCP, establishing foundational DevOps pipelines for the engineering environment.
- Engineered modular backend services and APIs, coordinating the integration and merging of distributed services into a cohesive production system.
- Collaborated across frontend and backend teams to align data models and API endpoints, significantly reducing integration bottlenecks and ensuring seamless client-server communication.

Facilitated learning for a large undergraduate programming course.

- Facilitated weekly office hours to mentor 300+ students, explaining complex programming concepts (OOP, data structures, memory management) and guiding code debugging in C++.
- Delivered interactive recitation lectures to classes of 25 students, successfully stepping in for Graduate Teaching Assistants to explain algorithmic concepts.

Served as a Learning Assistant for Math 102.

- Responsible for preparing and teaching recitation material assigned by the instructors.
- Assisted students in solving recitation worksheets.
- Taught approximately 50 students across two classes.

Served as a Learning Assistant for Math 101.

- Responsible for preparing and teaching recitation material assigned by the instructors.
- Taught approximately 50 students across two classes.
